none.description: Copy the entire current creature count of one friendly stack for two rounds. The phantom deals normal copied damage, has Phantom Integrity equal to current source health x min(40%, 20% + 0.15% x Spell Power), takes 25% physical damage and 200% magical damage, and leaves no remains or strategic resources.

none.description: Seal one stack against all magic. On a friendly target, remove hostile magical effects and preserve beneficial effects; on an enemy target, remove beneficial effects and preserve hostile effects. Duration is min(3, 1 + floor(Spell Power / 80)) rounds. Existing timed effects continue functioning while their timers are frozen; Orders are unaffected.
